topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I reckoned the knock on the door would be another one of the townsmen come to remind me about the taxes. But it was a letter, wrapped tight and sealed with a wax crest I've never seen before. They say it's for the old smith, who moved on to the next village, peace be with him. I coulda kept it, they said, or sent it on, but what's to be done when the hand that wrote the address is long gone from these parts? The campo is calling, the soil needs tending, but this letter weighs heavy in my hands, like a stone pulled from the earth. Best be careful, I reckon, lest I end up owing more to the saints or the miller. I'll take it to the priest, perhaps he knows what's to be done.
